notes.title: Steam Page is LIVE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/930c41124fa8e5008efe6229e7bc26c4fd4a5992.png[/img]

[h3]DEV UPDATE[/h3]
Hey guys, Matt here!

What's new with us? As you can see, we've set the Crowsworn Steam page [b]LIVE[/b]! Beyond that, we've been focused on implementing new features into the game, in order to prepare some badass surprises for you all in our upcoming debut on Kickstarter!

[h3]UPCOMING INTERVIEWS[/h3]
First, I will be appearing on The Indie Gamer Podcast today (in less than an hour!): 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-7NgnKRJRBE]The Indie Gamer on Youtube[/url]

Also, Aleksandar Kuzmanovic - Crowsworn's lead designer - will be appearing on Relyea's livestream next Tuesday, alongside a couple of other game developers with recent Kickstarter campaigns: 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcfvTI7n27O7urmoPvHmXeg]Relyea on Youtube[/url]

[h3]FOLLOW US[/h3]
[b]We're deep in prep-work for the upcoming Kickstarter campaign, which is shaping up to be a huge event and can be followed here: 
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania?ref=1x7fst]Follow Crowsworn on Kickstarter[/url][/b]

For (closer to) real-time updates from us, you should follow us on our Twitter account: 
[url=https://www.twitter.com/MongooseRodeo]Mongoose Rodeo on Twitter[/url]

And finally, if you're a member of the press, you can find our presskit link on our official Crowsworn website: 
[url=https://www.crowsworn.com]Crowsworn's Official Website[/url]

See you all soon on Kickstarter!
 ~ Matt
